events.description: Group of police officers in riot gear running and maneuvering in a chaotic, smoke-filled environment near a large monument (Arc de Triomphe), with visible crowd unrest and projectiles (e.g., red object at f8), consistent with violent protest response.

Group of police officers in riot gear actively engaging with an unseen crowd amid smoke and chaos near a large stone monument; officers are running, forming lines, and using shields, consistent with managing violent unrest.
Close-quarters physical struggle between multiple officers and at least one individual near the monument wall; visible grappling, pushing, and use of batons/shields in direct contact.

Group of police officers in riot gear engaged in a violent confrontation with demonstrators near a stone structure (Arc de Triomphe), involving physical pushing, use of shields, and objects being thrown (e.g., rocks) by demonstrators.

Direct physical combat between police and demonstrators: officers push against demonstrators using shields and batons; individuals are seen grappling, being shoved against the wall, and one demonstrator in yellow vest is visibly struck or pinned at 14.0–15.5s.

Police in riot gear clash with demonstrators near the Arc de Triomphe; demonstrators throw large rocks at officers while officers use shields and batons, with visible crowd unrest and projectile impacts.
Close-quarters physical confrontations occur between individual police officers and demonstrators, including shoving, grappling, and use of batons against individuals near the monument wall.

Large-scale violent unrest involving police in riot gear and individuals in high-visibility vests, with visible smoke/tear gas deployment and chaotic movement; consistent with a riot as defined by collective violent clashes.
Chaotic scene with heavy smoke or tear gas, police in riot gear advancing, and individuals in high-visibility vests moving erratically; consistent with violent group unrest and clashes.

Large group of protesters in yellow vests occupying a city street, with smoke (likely from tear gas or burning objects) rising in the background, overturned object on road, and agitated crowd movement consistent with violent unrest.
